snippet.title: Windrose: Drunken Sailor (2026 Remaster)
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041230

We liked the old Alpha "Drunken Sailor" trailer much, and so did you. But there were a lot of changes since Summer, so we had to re-shoot it almost entirely to keep it up-to-date. Check out the brand-new piretey-shiny 2026 version and let us know if you like it better. YARRRRR!
